method: Source review of the AIsaServices handler at the pinned commit: the route registration, the submit handler's request checks, and the handler-owned contract descriptor that AIsaServices publishes for createVideoGeneration. Each mirror field was compared with the descriptor; no live provider call was made.

observations.result: POST /v1/video/generations is registered with cost-quote support and API-key authentication.
A request without model is rejected with 400 model_required, also in quote mode. The mirror declares model as the only required field.

observations.fact: model must be an enabled catalog model
observations.result: An unknown model is rejected with 404 model_not_found. The mirror points callers to GET /v1/models.

After model normalization the body is forwarded to the selected model. The mirror keeps additionalProperties true and describes prompt, content, duration, resolution, ratio, generate_audio and watermark as optional model fields.
The mirror request body schema is identical to mediaVideoRequestSchema, field for field.
A created task is returned with 202; the mirror declares no response, so responses stay with the runtime contract.

limits: Model-specific constraints (accepted durations, resolutions, ratios, reference media) are validated by the selected model and are not enumerated.
